$comment: Project knowledge only. Anything here that every project would copy verbatim belongs in orch instead.

verify.$comment: How the acceptance hook (hooks/session-idle) is bounded. retryCap caps how many times a failing verification re-prompts the agent before the task lands on needs-review.

scheduler.$comment: Auto-dispatch of todo tasks (wait_human_start: false only): the daemon fills free maxConcurrent slots with the next unclaimed task. opencode-orchestrator turns this on by default for `orch init` and `orch project create`; a cloned project starts with it off. Edit with `orch project scheduler <n>`; only the committed copy on the base branch applies.

cron.$comment: Scheduled opencode jobs, evaluated by the daemon every tick in the machine's local time. Each entry needs a name, a five-field cron schedule (minute hour day month weekday) and a prompt (inline markdown) or promptFile (a committed path); model and agent are optional. Manage them with `orch cron list|add|update|remove` or the list_jobs/add_job/update_job/remove_job tools. The daemon opens a session on the base worktree when a slot comes due; the title carries the slot, so a restart cannot replay it. Set enabled to true to arm these jobs.

jobs.name: qa
jobs.prompt: Run the project's QA checks and report what failed. Do not change product code; summarize failures, evidence, and the smallest fix.

jobs.name: security
jobs.prompt: Review the last hour of changes for security problems (secrets, injection, unsafe shell, authz gaps) and report findings. Do not change code.
